title: PropertyFinder UAE Scraper
description: Collect UAE property listings for sale and for rent from PropertyFinder category pages: price, rooms, size, location, agent, agency, photos and dates. Pay per listing.
readme:
# PropertyFinder UAE Scraper

Collect property listings from [PropertyFinder](https://www.propertyfinder.ae), the UAE property portal, for sale and for rent. Paste a PropertyFinder category page link and get one structured row per listing: price, bedrooms, size, location tree, map position, agent, agency, photos, amenities and dates.

## What you can do with it

- Track asking prices and new listings in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or any other emirate.
- Compare sale and rental prices by community, building or property type.
- Build lists of listings together with the agency and agent shown on the page.
- Feed a spreadsheet, dashboard or alert with fresh listings every day.

An empty input (`{}`) runs a small demo: 5 listings for sale.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `startUrls` | string[] | PropertyFinder category pages, for example `https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/buy/dubai/apartments-for-sale.html` or `.../en/rent/dubai/apartments-for-rent.html`. The only query parameter accepted is `page`, which sets the first page to read. Addresses that carry other parameters, and `/en/search?...` result pages, are refused with a clear message. | demo link (Dubai apartments for sale) |
| `maxResults` | integer | Maximum listings for each category page, 1 to 1000. | 50 (5 in the demo) |

Each results page holds 20 to 30 listings, so 50 listings take 2 or 3 pages. Sponsored new-development cards in the results are not listings and are skipped.

Example for sale and for rent in one run:

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/buy/dubai/apartments-for-sale.html",
    "https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/rent/dubai/apartments-for-rent.html"
  ],
  "maxResults": 40
}
```

Example starting at page 3 of one category:

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/buy/dubai/apartments-for-sale.html?page=3"],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

Numbers may be given as text (`"100"`). A value that is not a number stops the run with a clear message in the run status.

## Output

One row per listing. Fields the page does not show are `null`.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `listingId`, `reference`, `url`, `sourceListingId` | Listing id, the agent reference, the link, and the internal key |
| `title`, `description` | Headline and full description |
| `propertyType`, `purpose`, `offeringType` | Type such as Apartment or Villa, `buy` or `rent`, and the site label |
| `price`, `currency`, `pricePeriod`, `priceHidden` | Price as a number in AED, rent period (`yearly`, `monthly` and so on), null for sales |
| `pricePerSqft`, `priceChange`, `numberOfCheques` | Price per square foot, recent price change in percent, rent cheques offered |
| `bedrooms`, `isStudio`, `bathrooms` | Rooms (a studio has 0 bedrooms) |
| `sizeSqft`, `sizeSqm` | Built-up area in both units |
| `furnishing`, `completionStatus`, `isNewConstruction`, `isDirectFromDeveloper` | Furnishing, completion status and build flags |
| `permitNumber` | Regulatory permit number when the listing shows one |
| `locationName`, `locationFullName`, `locationType`, `locationPath` | Location as shown |
| `city`, `community`, `subCommunity`, `building`, `locationTree` | Location hierarchy |
| `latitude`, `longitude` | Map position |
| `listedDate`, `updatedDate` | Dates from the listing (UTC) |
| `isVerified`, `isAvailable`, `isFeatured`, `isPremium`, `isExclusive`, `isPriceDrop`, `isGreatValue`, `isHighDemand`, `isLuxe`, `listingLevel` | Listing flags and level |
| `agentId`, `agentName`, `agentUrl`, `agentImage`, `agentEmail`, `agentLanguages`, `agentIsSuperAgent` | Agent shown on the listing |
| `agencyId`, `agencyName`, `agencyUrl`, `agencyLogo`, `agencyAddress`, `agencyEmail`, `agencyPhone` | Agency shown on the listing |
| `agencyLicenseNumber`, `agentLicenseNumber` | Licence numbers (ORN, BRN) when the listing text states them |
| `imageCount`, `images`, `firstImage`, `videoUrl`, `view360Url`, `floorPlans` | Media shown on the results page |
| `amenities`, `amenityCodes` | Amenity names and codes |
| `searchUrl`, `page`, `position`, `query`, `scrapedAt` | Which results page found the listing, and the UTC collection time |

Results are de-duplicated by listing id within a run, also after a restart.

## Run outcomes

| Situation | Result |
|-----------|--------|
| Listings found | Run succeeds, status "Delivered N listings." |
| Search has no listings | Run succeeds with 0 rows, nothing is charged, and the status says so |
| The charge limit you set is reached | Run succeeds and stops, status "Stopped at the max charge limit. N listings delivered." |
| PropertyFinder does not answer any request | Run fails with a status that says what happened. Retry later. |
| Input is not valid (for example `maxResults` is not a number) | Run fails at the start with the reason in the status |

## Pricing

Pay per event:

| Event | Name | Price |
|-------|------|-------|
| Run start, charged once with the first delivered rows | `actor-start` | $0.001 |
| One listing delivered | `propertyfinder-listing-result` | $0.90 per 1,000 |

Nothing is charged when no listing is delivered. If you set a maximum total charge for the run, the run stops before a row would go over it. See the Pricing tab for current prices.

## Limitations

- The actor reads search result pages. It does not open each listing page, so each listing shows up to 4 photos (`imageCount` has the total) and no phone number of the individual agent.
- A search shows at most a few thousand pages in total, and this actor returns up to 1000 listings per category page. Use a narrower category page for a smaller market.
- New-development project cards that PropertyFinder mixes into the results are not included. Only individual listings are returned.
- Licence numbers are only filled when the listing text states them. Many listings do not.
- Rental rows have no `pricePerSqft`, and many listings have no completion status, permit number, video or floor plan.
- Listings change quickly. A listing can move to another page between two requests, and a long run may miss one or return it near the end of a page.
- The site can answer with errors at busy times. The actor tries each page up to 3 times with a short pause, then skips that page and continues. After 2 skipped pages in a row it ends that category. The run status says how many pages were skipped.
- Search result pages (`/en/search?...`) and links with filter or sort parameters are not supported. Use a category page.

## FAQ

**Can I scrape both sale and rental listings?**
Yes. Use a category page under `/en/buy/` for sale and `/en/rent/` for rent. You can mix both in one run.

**How many listings can I get from one category page?**
Up to 1000 per category page. Use narrower category pages (a community, a property type) to cover a larger market.

**Why do some fields come back empty?**
Listings only show what the agency published. Sale rows have no rent period, and many listings have no permit number, video or floor plan.

**How fresh is the data?**
Each run reads the live search pages, so rows reflect PropertyFinder at the time of the run. `scrapedAt` records the time.

**Which search order is used?**
The order of the category page as the site shows it. The actor adds no sort or filter parameters.

**What happens if I stop or restart the run?**
Progress is saved after every batch. A restarted run continues from the saved page and does not repeat or re-charge rows already delivered.

## Data protection

The actor returns what PropertyFinder shows publicly on search result pages, including the agent name and the agency contact details the agency published. It does not log in and it does not collect personal data about buyers or tenants. You are responsible for using the data in line with PropertyFinder's terms and with data protection law, especially if you contact agents or combine the data with other sources.

## Support

Questions or a field you need? Open an issue on the Issues tab of this actor, or write to contact@nanoscrape.com.
